site.title: Know your AI spend. Explain every difference.
site.subtitle: Connect provider billing and usage, reconcile invoice references, and find the cost signals that deserve your attention.
site.noProxy: No proxy. No SDK changes. Your prompts stay out.
site.oneBody: OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, and a precise CSV import path for other reports.
site.twoBody: Original currency, source windows, cost basis, and revisions remain visible behind each amount.
site.threeBody: Compare an invoice reference with reported costs, then record what explains the result.
site.integrationsIntro: Know what each source can actually report.
site.readOnly: MinoDuck only performs billing and usage reads. Some provider credentials have broader permissions; file import remains available.
site.docsIntro: Start with a source you can verify.
site.docsSteps: Create a workspace. Connect a billing account or import the CSV template. Check the date range and cost basis. Add an invoice reference, confirm its comparable scope, and run reconciliation.
site.securityBody: Provider credentials use authenticated encryption. Browser sessions use HttpOnly cookies. Workspace membership is checked on the server; financial tables apply PostgreSQL row-level security. Source files and exports use private storage.
site.legalDraft: Pre-release information. The operating entity, contact details, retention policy, and legal terms must be finalized before public paid availability.
site.privacyBody: MinoDuck processes account details and billing/usage records to provide cost analysis. Prompt and completion content is outside the product scope. Billing data is not sent to a language model for summaries.
site.termsBody: Subscriptions are fixed-price in USD. Annual plans charge the full annual amount upfront. Cancellations take effect at period end without automatic prorated refunds. Billing differences and special cases require manual review.
